title: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay
why: External memory refined by comparing repeated attempts at the same task; experiences merged, conflicts resolved via applicability conditions; no weight updates.

title: Learning to Compose: Recursive Self-Improvement of Shared Executable Stacks for Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
why: Shared executable stack (tools, skills, handoffs, verifiers) repaired from execution-trace failure attribution; selection and regression gates choose the next parent.

title: InstAgent: A Recursively Self-Improving Agent Operating System for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration
why: Agentic behavior-tree collaboration programs updated from execution feedback; successful revisions preserved for reuse in future multi-robot tasks.

title: The World Won't Wait: Evaluating and Teaching Agents Under a Live Clock
why: TORSI: slow teacher studies failures offline and writes reusable instructions for a fast student; validation scores decide which instruction updates are adopted.

title: D-World: An Explicit World-Language-Action Model with Recursive Self-Improvement under Dual Control
why: Executable digital-twin world model (code, physical parameters) revised against robot measurements; revisions accepted only if replay residuals do not increase.

title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
why: Waveform generator repaired from construction errors and interventions searched from learner errors; learner itself trained, so harness role is partial.

title: Multimodal Filesystem Memory For Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
why: Agent consolidates episodic experience into semantic and procedural memory (reusable methods) in a filesystem store, reused across long-horizon tasks.

title: Self-Building Labs
why: Laboratory agent builds its own missing capabilities (layout, digital twin, robot skills, workflows) from a goal; check whether built skills persist and improve.

title: Can LLMs predict the outcomes of machine learning experiments?
why: Audit for RSI-style research loops: how well LLMs pre-judge self-generated ML experiment ideas before running them, i.e. reliability of a selection signal.

title: Language Models Learn to Improve Language Models
why: Proposer is RL-trained (weights), but its research world-model reward is a frozen LLM whose in-context record grows with measured outcomes.

title: DarKnight: Retrieval-Guided Agentic Framework for Breaking Dark Web CAPTCHA Gates
why: Described as self-improving retrieval-guided agent on small local VLMs without per-site training; check what store grows from solved attempts.

title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments
why: Evaluator co-evolution: hacker-fixer loop finds verifier exploits and repairs verifier code iteratively, defenses strengthening with more loop iterations.

title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
why: Simulation data engine's generation and training programs refined from a shared memory of critic-validated policy failures and learning progress; policy weights also trained.

title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
why: Coding agent builds and recursively improves task models within a harness plus verifier; improvement driven by verifier outcomes on its own outputs.

title: COLLEAGUE.SKILL: Automated AI Skill Generation via Expert Knowledge Distillation
why: Skill packages generated from heterogeneous person/role traces into versioned, correctable skills; signal is expert material rather than own execution feedback.

title: TaxoSkill: Taxonomy-Guided Skill Optimization for Self-Evolving Agents
why: Repo (anonymous COLING submission): skills optimized per discovered task type, rollouts allocated by taxonomy; signal from rollout outcomes. No arXiv id found.

title: When Memory Undermines Rules in Self-Evolving Agents
why: Repo (anonymous paper code): audits whether user rules keep force as agents rewrite procedural memory between tasks. No arXiv id found.

title: Self-Evolving Agent Teams
why: Repo: frozen evolver rewrites team genome (roles, prompts, tool code, workflow) from evaluation and failures; child kept only if better. No arXiv id.

title: dsh-plugin-recursive-optimizer: recursive agent/prompt/skill optimizer for DeepSeek Harness
why: Repo: Harness²-style propose-probe-compose-reflect loop on agents, prompts, skills; only strictly improving candidates advance, lessons persisted. No arXiv id.

title: harness2-redteam: evolving a red-teaming attacker harness with Harness²
why: Repo extending anchor Harness²: attacker harness evolved by contrastive probe loop, metric attack success; README states no results yet. No arXiv id.

title: RSI-Inference Bench: A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Self-Improving Inference Systems
why: Repo (paper coming soon): benchmark where coding agents optimize and repair LLM inference engines, graded by execution. No arXiv id yet.
